# Honest Invoice

> AI-powered invoicing and estimating for contractors, freelancers, and service businesses.

## Product

Honest Invoice turns plain-English job descriptions into draft labor and material line items for estimates and invoices. Users review the result, send professional documents, and can collect payments through Stripe on eligible plans.

## Best fit

- Contractors and independent service businesses
- HVAC contractors
- Plumbers
- Electricians
- Landscapers
- Cleaners
- Freelancers and consultants
- Small service businesses

## Positioning

Honest Invoice is focused on fast estimates and invoicing rather than trying to replace a full accounting or field-service management suite.
